subject: Easy way to MR over multiple files?

messages.author: bfeca3c6fa2356fa
messages.subject: Easy way to MR over multiple files?
parts:
Dear all,

Is there an easy way to MR over multiple input files? I currently have a large
HIVE table that contains tab-separated columns and which has been split
into parts (/user/hive/warehouse/table/000000_0 , .../000001_0, .../000002_0, ...)

What I do now is using "hdfs dfs -cat ..." to create one big file on HDFS. But I was
wondering if I missed a more convenient approach...

Kind regards,

Renald

messages.author: 6ac7e7dfbe4f6c38
messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#1165] Easy way to MR over multiple files?
parts:
Hi,
just specify all of them as input

```
mapreduce(c("file1", "file2", ....) ...)
```

They will be processed in arbitrary order (files and records). You can't assume much of anything, even if usually I don't see any strange permutation going on I've never seen a written guarantee and we must assume it's implementation dependent (I am talking Hadoop implementation, not rmr2)


Antonio
